description: A school employs staff and substitute teachers. Per shift, staff teachers work 6 hours and get paid $300. Per shift, substitute teachers work 3 hours and get paid $100. For the summer term, the school requires 1000 hours of teaching availability. If the school has a budget of $40000, how many of each teacher should be hired to minimize the total number of teachers?

StaffShiftHours.definition: Number of hours worked per shift by a staff teacher

StaffShiftPay.definition: Payment per shift to a staff teacher

SubstituteShiftHours.definition: Number of hours worked per shift by a substitute teacher

SubstituteShiftPay.definition: Payment per shift to a substitute teacher

TotalTeachingHours.definition: Total required teaching hours for the summer term

TotalBudget.definition: Total budget allocated for teacher payments

objective.description: "Minimize the total number of teachers hired (staff and substitute combined)"

constraints.description: 6 * (Number of staff teachers) + 3 * (Number of substitute teachers) >= 1000
300 * (Number of staff teachers) + 100 * (Number of substitute teachers) <= 40000
Number of staff teachers >= 0 and Number of substitute teachers >= 0
Number of staff teachers and number of substitute teachers must be integers

StaffTeachers.definition: Number of staff teachers hired for the summer term

SubstituteTeachers.definition: Number of substitute teachers hired for the summer term
